# Naim Bin Hasan, Full-Stack Web Developer

> Naim Bin Hasan is a freelance full-stack web developer with 100+ projects delivered since 2019, Top Rated status and a 100% Job Success score on Upwork. He builds scalable web apps, SaaS products, SEO-friendly CMS websites, dashboards, e-commerce and API integrations, on a modern, maintainable stack. He is also a PhD researcher in Information Science and Technology at Syracuse University and is based in Syracuse, New York (US Eastern Time).

## Experience
- Research software and web tools, Syracuse University iSchool (Fall 2026 to present): interactive web tools and AI-supported learning resources for Gravity Spy / LIGO.
- Lead Full-Stack Developer (promoted 2023) and Junior Web Developer (2020 to 2022), Zilberman Insurance, remote.
- Freelance Full-Stack Developer, Upwork and Fiverr (2019 to 2023).
- Lead Web Developer, AmaderKantho24, Dhaka, part-time (Jun 2019 to Jan 2020).

## Services
- Custom web apps and SaaS
- SEO-friendly CMS websites
- Dashboards and real-time apps
- E-commerce and payments
- API integrations (Twilio, WhatsApp, Meta, Salesforce, REST)
- Upgrades, fixes and new features on existing applications

## Selected projects
- DOHPS: nonprofit website and CMS
- Scholarly journal platform
- EduKit: college counseling tool
- Ezorders: restaurant and catering ordering
- reopen.chat: live chat rooms
- Renewal: Salesforce contract manager
